title: ehretia dicksonii var. tomentosa
intro: Ehretia dicksonii var. tomentosa, commonly known as the hairy silverbush, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ehretia dicksonii var. tomentosa include antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
